limitations: Cold project opening still validates preserved model material and may take minutes; no new model latency or GPU performance claim
Stopping an owned local generation can unload its server; the next request reloads it
An unowned remote server without cancellation proof remains quarantined after disconnect
General and project chats retain separate workspace histories
Token counts are provider-reported usage for the latest completed request
requestAnimationFrame follows display scheduling; no claim of measured 120/144/240 Hz throughput
GitHub Enterprise and full live-account end-to-end validation are not included
No 8-hour or 24-hour run started; previous P14 acceptance evidence retains its original source identity
